rates.source: U.S. Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates

data_quality.reason: Broad multi-expiry strike and OI coverage

dealer_positioning.model: Modeled from listed multi-expiry OI/IV and Black-Scholes sensitivities; not direct dealer inventory.

options.model: Estimated GEX using listed option OI and modeled gamma; not direct dealer book.
options.gex_methodology: Multi-expiry Black-Scholes gamma model from listed OI/IV; calls positive, puts negative by dealer-sign assumption.
model_notes: Uses up to 12 nearest current/future expirations to improve structure versus single-expiry GEX.
0DTE uses time remaining to the modeled 4:00 p.m. ET expiry.
Gamma flip is interpolated from the aggregate price-response profile.
Vanna and Charm are analytical estimates from the same OI/IV snapshot.
Dealer side is inferred by a conventional sign assumption; actual dealer inventory is not observable here.

sources: U.S. Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates

cot.reporting_basis: Tuesday positions, generally released Friday 3:30 p.m. ET
